fixtureProvenance: SYNTHETIC — generated by packages/evals/src/composition-families.mjs from fixed seeds. Not captured scenes. The captured fixtures in this repo remain tasks-visual/regression/golem-plaza-{baseline,improved}.
groundTruth: fixture-author design intent, NOT an independent blind jury. Weaker than the twelve-rung ladder, whose labels came from six blind critics.

metricTable.falsifiedReason: the central hypothesis of the original work, refuted: a composed scene and a tiled carpet spread edge energy alike once both fill the frame
the same idea inverted; measured direction contradicts the declared one
does not GRADE palette; retained ONLY as a floor against total greyness
1-stud clustering fuses a paved scene into one mass
direction refuted — the bad fixtures are the ones that fill the frame
perfect score but excluded: the framing camera follows the bounding box, so a uniform translation cancels exactly

enclosureAnalysis.what: verticalElementHeights clusters parts in plan at a 3-stud gap. In an enclosed or wall-adjacent scene the shell chains through every prop that touches it, so the whole build collapses to ONE vertical element. verticalDominance then returns its 1.0 "nothing dominates" sentinel and the gate reports "no landmark" on a scene that has no landmark tier to measure in the first place.

enclosedCameraAnalysis.what: The framing camera orbits the geometry bounding box, so on a roofed scene every viewpoint sees the OUTSIDE of a lidded box. See sheets/interior.png: a fully furnished room renders as a beige lid. The pixel half of the gate therefore never sees interior composition at all, and its greyscale floor is applied to a roof.

counterfactuals.name: A: skip the landmark rule when verticalElements === 1
counterfactuals.why: a single fused mass is an enclosure (room, cave, house shell), not a failed landmark contest; verticalDominance returns the 1.0 sentinel there and the gate reads it as a failure

counterfactuals.name: B: verticalDominance floor 1.25 -> 1.05
counterfactuals.why: a colonnade or a paired-tower composition is legitimate and lands just above 1.0

counterfactuals.name: C: colourfulness floor 12 -> 8
counterfactuals.why: a deliberately desaturated genre scene (horror, cave) is not the same failure as a grey slab

cameraSensitivity.note: The structural half of the gate reads SceneLayout geometry and never sees a camera, so it is camera-invariant BY CONSTRUCTION. Only the pixel half (maskedColorfulness in the gate; the rest reported to the critic) can move with the camera.
